Subject: CAIQ pre-fill + log sample guidance

Hi Alex — attaching a CAIQ pre-fill (high level) and a short PDF with options for extracting log samples from Hosted and Dedicated deployments. A couple of clarifications before the call: 

1) Log sampling: for telemetry we typically ask for 3 non-contiguous 24-hour windows (UTC) to show retention/ingest behavior. If you prefer a single 7-day contiguous window we can accept that but it increases transfer size.
2) Redaction: we can accept logs with PII redacted; please include a short manifest describing redaction rules so our compliance team can validate.
3) Access: pre-signed S3 is our recommendation for larger bundles (>5GB); SFTP works for smaller transfers and for customers with existing SFTP policies.

Attachments: redwood_caiq-matrix.xlsx, log_sample_instructions.pdf

See you at 10:00. I’ll be leading the CAIQ walkthrough.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
